title: Halving Loop
prompt: n = 40 is given. Print n after each halving (40, 20, 10, 5, 2) while it is at least 2 — using integer division and a while loop.

tests.name: halving sequence
tests.code:
assert printed == ["40", "20", "10", "5", "2"], f"got {printed}"
assert "while" in code, "use a while loop"
tests.hint: while n >= 2: print(n); n //= 2 — //= is augmented floor division.
